Instrument.name: The Linear Etalon Imaging Spectral Array (L'LEISA) of the L'Ralph Imager/Spectrometer for Lucy
Instrument.description: The Linear Etalon Imaging Spectral Array (L'LEISA) of the L'Ralph instrument is an infrared spectrometer with a spectral range of 1.0 - 3.6 microns and spectral resolution of 10 nm. Infrared light entering the Ralph aperture is directed to LEISA by a beam splitter.
